note: Competition and seat data for the examinations that gate entry to a profession. Gates are SHARED — sixteen professions sit behind JEE Main, five behind NEET, five behind CAT — so the numbers live here once and professions reference them by key, the same fetch-once-reuse pattern as verified_facts.json. Sourcing per profession would mean dozens of copies that drift apart.
why_this_exists: The opportunity cost of PREPARATION is the largest risk the schema could not express. A candidate can spend three to six years on a government examination and hold no credential at the end. That is not the same as gaining nothing — see if_unsuccessful, which separates the credential (often none) from the knowledge and the adjacent routes it opens (often substantial). Failed preparation is partly sunk and partly carried forward; it is NOT waste at full weight.
the_money_for_odds_trade: A private_reputed gate is usually winnable at odds a public gate is not, for a much larger fee. Reporting the odds without the cost tells a rich student the truth and a poor one a lie, so typical_total_cost_lakh is mandatory on every private gate. MEDICINE IS THE EXCEPTION: NEET governs government, private and deemed colleges alike, so there money cannot buy the door open.

mechanisms.seat_limited: A fixed number of places. Competition is applicants per seat.
mechanisms.attrition_limited: No quota — anyone who clears the standard passes. The filter is the pass rate, and the risk is repeated attempts rather than rejection.
mechanisms.distributed: One common test feeding MANY independent admissions with no national seat pool. A national applicants-per-seat ratio would be meaningless — competition is per programme and per university, and varies enormously between them. applicants_per_seat stays null on purpose.

upsc-cse.name: UPSC Civil Services Examination

if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: Working knowledge of Indian polity, economy, history, geography and current affairs, and the discipline of multi-year self-directed study. Genuinely valued in policy, journalism, teaching and coaching, and it transfers directly to every other government examination. What it is not is a qualification anyone can verify on paper.

upsc-cse.note: 1,087 vacancies were notified for CSE 2025 and 958 candidates were finally recommended, against roughly 10 to 11 lakh applicants — a selection rate near 0.1 percent. Seats here are the candidates actually recommended, not the vacancies notified.

neet-ug.name: NEET UG

if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: The Physics, Chemistry and Biology preparation is a full class 11-12 syllabus mastered to a high standard, and it carries directly into every other health-science degree the same score admits you to. Unlike a government-examination attempt, the years are spent inside school, so a candidate still leaves with a class 12 certificate.

neet-ug.note: 22,09,318 candidates appeared in 2025 against 1,18,190 MBBS seats across 766 colleges. Of those, 12,36,531 qualified, so roughly 1 in 10 QUALIFIED candidates gets an MBBS seat. NO PRIVATE BYPASS EXISTS — see verified_facts.json#neet-ug-eligibility. NEET governs government, private and deemed colleges alike, so this is the one gate in the registry where money cannot convert a competition problem into a cost problem. PREPARATION IS BIMODAL and the single boolean cannot say so: most candidates prepare inside class 11 and 12, but the DROP YEAR is a large and normal part of this gate — a full-time year, sometimes two, spent repeating with no schooling attached. For a dropper preparation_is_full_time is effectively true and the year counts as sunk in the same way a government-examination year does.

cat.name: CAT (Common Admission Test)

transfers_to: CAT reattempt with no age or attempt limit
if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: Quantitative aptitude, data interpretation and verbal reasoning, which transfer to every other management entrance and to the aptitude rounds most employers run. Most CAT candidates prepare while working or studying rather than full time, so the year is rarely lost outright.

cat.note: About 3.5 lakh registrations against 8,425 seats across the IIMs, IITs and top non-IIM schools. That ratio is for the TOP TIER ONLY — several hundred business schools accept CAT, so entry to SOME MBA is far easier than this number suggests. There is no age limit and no attempt cap.

clat.name: CLAT (Common Law Admission Test)

transfers_to: any bachelor's then a three-year LLB
if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: Legal reasoning, comprehension and current affairs. The five-year LLB is not the only route into law — a three-year LLB after any degree reaches the same Bar Council enrolment — so missing CLAT delays the profession rather than closing it.

clat.note: Roughly 92,344 registrations against 3,711 five-year LLB seats across the National Law Universities. Private law schools take a large additional intake outside CLAT.

ca-foundation.name: CA Foundation (ICAI)

transfers_to: B.Com and other commerce degrees taken in parallel
if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: Accounting, law, economics and quantitative aptitude at a standard well above a commerce degree. Most candidates take CA Foundation ALONGSIDE a B.Com rather than instead of one, so an unsuccessful attempt usually leaves the degree intact.

ca-foundation.note: NOT SEAT-LIMITED — there is no quota and nobody is competing for a place. The filter is the pass mark: 90,217 appeared in May 2026 and 18,124 passed, a rate of 20.09 percent, and Intermediate is harder still at about 9.4 percent. Attrition, not competition, is what removes people.

bitsat.name: BITSAT

if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: The same Physics, Chemistry and Maths preparation as JEE, which transfers to every other engineering entrance in the country.

bitsat.note: About 4,000 seats across the BITS campuses, roughly 1,040 of them at Pilani. THE APPLICANT COUNT IS NOT RECORDED because it was not found in a source — it is left null rather than estimated. Total cost for the four-year B.Tech is roughly 22 to 25 lakh, which is the point: this route trades money for odds. POSITIONED AS AN ALTERNATIVE, not a primary. BITSAT was added to this registry before JEE Main was, which was incoherent — it is the private alternative to a public gate that had been deferred, so twenty professions briefly showed a private route as their only quantified door. A private gate may no longer be recorded without its public primary.

jee-main.name: JEE Main

transfers_to: diploma then lateral entry into B.Tech year 2
if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics mastered to a standard well beyond the school syllabus, which transfers to every other engineering entrance in the country and to the aptitude rounds employers run years later. Preparation happens alongside class 11 and 12, so a candidate still leaves with a class 12 certificate — unlike a government-examination attempt taken after a degree.

jee-main.note: 14,75,103 candidates in 2025 against 62,853 JoSAA seats across 128 institutes — 23 IITs, 31 NITs, IIEST, 26 IIITs and 47 other government-funded institutes. JEE Main is also the qualifying stage for JEE Advanced: the top 2.5 lakh rank holders become eligible. Admits roughly a three-year window of class 12 cohorts, which is what entry_window records.

jee-advanced.name: JEE Advanced

transfers_to: diploma then lateral entry into B.Tech year 2
if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics mastered to a standard well beyond the school syllabus, which transfers to every other engineering entrance in the country and to the aptitude rounds employers run years later. Preparation happens alongside class 11 and 12, so a candidate still leaves with a class 12 certificate — unlike a government-examination attempt taken after a degree.

jee-advanced.note: Only the top 2.5 lakh JEE Main rank holders may sit it; 54,378 qualified in 2025 for 18,160 IIT seats. Measured against the full JEE Main pool an IIT seat is closer to 81:1 — the 13.8:1 here is measured from the 2.5 lakh who are permitted to appear, which is the honest denominator for someone who has already cleared JEE Main.

cuet-ug.name: CUET UG

if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: The class 12 syllabus itself, revised to examination standard. Because CUET feeds ordinary degree programmes rather than a scarce professional seat, an unsuccessful candidate almost always still starts a degree somewhere in the same year.

cuet-ug.note: 13,54,699 registered and 10,71,735 appeared in 2025 — the largest gate in this registry by candidate count, and the one most professions reference. NO NATIONAL SEAT POOL EXISTS: CUET feeds 45-plus central universities plus state, deemed and private ones across 37 subjects, each admitting independently. A national ratio would be a fiction, so applicants_per_seat is null by design. Real competition is per programme — Delhi University English Honours and a small central university B.Sc are not the same contest.

gate.name: GATE

transfers_to: M.Tech admission at a lower-ranked institute
PSU recruitment in a later cycle
direct employment on the bachelor's degree
GATE reattempt — no age or attempt limit
if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: The entire undergraduate engineering syllabus consolidated to a depth most degrees never require. It transfers to PSU written tests, to campus placement aptitude rounds, and to any later postgraduate attempt.

gate.note: About 9.37 lakh registered and 7.47 lakh appeared in 2025, with roughly 1.4 lakh qualifying — near 18.7 percent. ATTRITION-LIMITED at the qualifying threshold, but the score then competes for scarce things: M.Tech seats, PSU recruitment, and ISRO Scientist/Engineer entry. Qualifying is not the same as getting a place.

csir-ugc-net.name: CSIR-UGC NET

transfers_to: PhD admission through a university or institute entrance
if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: Deep subject mastery at postgraduate level, which is the same preparation any PhD interview or institute entrance tests. Candidates hold an M.Sc already, so unlike a school-level gate there is a real degree underneath.

csir-ugc-net.note: 1,95,241 registered and 1,47,732 appeared in July 2025, with 21,295 qualifying for JRF, assistant professorship and PhD admission — 14.42 percent. Qualifying with JRF also carries the stipend recorded in verified_facts.json#csir-jrf-srf-stipend, which is why this gate decides whether a research career is financially survivable.

iit-jam.name: IIT JAM

transfers_to: M.Sc at a state or central university
CSIR-UGC NET route to a PhD
integrated PhD programmes at IISc and the IISERs
if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: Undergraduate science consolidated to honours depth, which transfers to every other M.Sc entrance and to CSIR-UGC NET a year later.

iit-jam.note: 3,007 postgraduate seats at the IITs for 2025-26, with more than 2,000 further seats at IISc, the NITs, IIEST and others through CCMN. THE APPLICANT COUNT WAS NOT FOUND in a source and is left null rather than estimated, so no ratio is shown.

ibps-po.name: IBPS PO

if_unsuccessful.non_credential_gain: Quantitative aptitude, reasoning and English at a standard shared across every Indian banking and staff-selection examination, so preparation for one is preparation for all of them. This is the most transferable preparation of any gate in the registry.

ibps-po.note: 5,208 Probationary Officer vacancies notified for 2025 across participating public sector banks. THE APPLICANT COUNT WAS NOT FOUND in a source and is left null. Recruitment runs in annual cycles, so a missed year is a delay rather than a closed door.

pending_gates: VITEEE, COMEDK, SRMJEEE — BLOCKED BY THEIR OWN RULE, correctly. Applicant counts and four-year costs were searched and not found at the precision the schema needs, and a private_reputed gate without typical_total_cost_lakh is rejected by audit.py. Adding them with a guessed cost is the exact failure the pairing rule was written to stop.

COMEDK carries a finding worth acting on when it is added: of 26,827 engineering seats at the start of 2025 counselling, only 9,637 were filled after four rounds — more than 17,000 vacant. Private engineering in Karnataka is not a competition gate at all; it is a COST gate. That inverts how private entrances should be presented, and it should be checked for VITEEE and SRMJEEE before either is recorded.
NDA and CDS — applicants and vacancies not yet fetched.
ACET (Institute of Actuaries of India) — applicant count not published prominently.
State Judicial Services — conducted state by state, no single national figure exists.
NMAT, SNAP, IIFT — private management entrances, cost and applicants not yet fetched.
NATA and B.Arch entrances — not yet fetched.
IMU CET, DGCA examinations, BARC OCES/DGFS — small specialist gates, not yet fetched.
COACHING COST is not recorded on any public gate. typical_total_cost_lakh is null on UPSC, NEET, CAT, CLAT, JEE and CUET, but Indian coaching is a real and often decisive family expense.
gate_pairing_rule:
A gate named as an ALTERNATIVE must sit beside a primary — showing only the fallback route hides the main one. But A PRIVATE GATE MAY ITSELF BE THE PRIMARY, and in several fields it is the only real way in: animation, game design, culinary arts, sound engineering and much of fashion have no public entrance examination at all. In that case the gate is the primary, it does NOT claim alternative_to, and its cost is still mandatory — because when the private route is the only route, the fee IS the entry barrier and hiding it would be the worst version of this error.

The rule was originally written as 'a private gate may not be recorded without its public primary'. That was too strong. It came from a real failure — BITSAT was added while JEE Main was deferred, so twenty engineering professions showed a 23.5 lakh private route as their only quantified door — but the fix over-corrected into forbidding a case that is legitimate and common. What was actually wrong there was that JEE Main EXISTED and had been skipped, not that a private gate was present.

Enforced in audit.py: alternative_gates require a primary_gate; a gate claiming alternative_to must point at a gate in this registry; every private_reputed gate states its cost.
primary_gate_rule: primary_gate is the gate that most DETERMINES whether someone reaches the profession — NOT the first one they sit. For every Sector 3 research profession the first gate is CUET, but CUET feeds ordinary B.Sc programmes with no national seat pool and is the easiest gate they face. The decisive one is CSIR-UGC NET, because the JRF stipend decides whether a research career is financially survivable at all, or IIT JAM for the M.Sc seat. Naming CUET as primary told a student the hard part was getting into a B.Sc. Precedence when several apply: CSIR-UGC NET, then IIT JAM, then GATE, then IBPS PO, then CUET. A private gate may hold this slot. Type does not decide precedence — DECISIVENESS does.
